name: A landscape in one chain
about: Three scenes without people in one pan, 48 frames per second.

data.title: Lake
data.text:
Photorealistic nature documentary look, golden hour light, rich colour, crisp detail.

Scene: a calm mountain lake at sunset, pine trees on the shore, no people.

Camera: wide shot, slow pan right.

Timeline:
[0s-5s] Golden light slides across the still water.

Audio: birdsong, gentle lapping water.

No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

data.title: Dusk
data.text:
Continue seamlessly from <Picture 1>.

Photorealistic nature documentary look, golden hour light, rich colour, crisp detail.

Scene continues at the same lake, no people.

Camera: wide shot, slow pan right.

Timeline:
[0s-5s] The sky deepens to violet and the first stars appear.

No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

A landscape in one chain.

With no people the whole chain is one continuous camera move: each continuation picks up the pan from the last frame. 48 frames per second make the motion smoother.
